resolutions.question: UI042 versus UI043
resolutions.resolution: UI_DECISIONS line644 explicitly withdraws only designed/purchased/purchase-proof categories;customer master,resume and exact dedup authorization remain. No global UI042 replacement.

resolutions.question: Fixed point size versus joint adaptive rules
resolutions.resolution: Existing published/confirmed versions retain original rules. New learned instances follow later joint-adaptation decision. Not one global override.

resolutions.question: Customer controls versus professional template editing
resolutions.resolution: Withdrawn customer font/width/single-double-row controls do not revoke approved professional template authoring. Audit role and entry,not labels alone.

resolutions.question: TRAIN style learning versus VALIDATION calibration
resolutions.resolution: Primary profiles are fitted onTRAIN. Separate validation calibration is conditional advice,not a new style truth or production qualification;sealedHOLDOUT never fits. Negative calibration evidence must not become positive support.

resolutions.question: Software implemented versus real AI quality
resolutions.resolution: Synthetic software mechanism and8partial/0full real-corpus qualification are distinct;do not rewrite original package counts.

resolutions.question: Old singleCodex/no-billing-proof prohibition
resolutions.resolution: Later included-tools decision supersedes cost blanket bans;platform/task delegation rules still apply. Current Git failure is authentication,not a budget gate.
